business_problem: ImagineArt needed higher-quality generative outputs and a unified production environment so users could build end-to-end ad and creative workflows without tool-hopping across separate text, image, audio, and video systems.
solution_summary: ImagineArt uses Google Cloud to address this challenge: ImagineArt needed higher-quality generative outputs and a unified production environment so users could build end-to-end ad and creative workflows without tool-hopping across separate text, image, audio, and video systems. Gemini acts as the reasoning engine inside Imagine Assist and Omni Agent to analyze user intent and preserve context across long-form creative tasks, serving as the compute layer. BigQuery consolidates global advertising and analytics data that inform campaign and creative workflows, serving as the storage layer. Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform supports the integrated agentic workflow and audio pipeline used during video development, serving as the serving layer. Veo 3 generates controllable video with camera, lighting, color, and character consistency for campaign production, serving as the compute layer.

business_outcome: ImagineArt shortened campaign launch cycles, simplified multimodal content production, and made advanced creative direction accessible to non-technical users.
architecture_clues: Over 50% of ImagineArt’s API costs are now attributed to Google models
Veo 3’s native audio pipeline removes dependence on separate third-party audio providers
The platform evolved from simple generation tools into multi-agent war-room style creative workflows
evidence_quotes: With a unified Google Cloud foundation, ImagineArt shifted from offering simple generation tools to developing comprehensive agentic workflows through Imagine Assist and Omni Agent.
Veo 3 provides granular control over camera movements, lighting, and colors, while ensuring character consistency across video frames.
Nano Banana excels at producing high-resolution imagery with the unique capability to edit and visualize text accurately within a scene.
data_flow: Creative and analytics context is centralized in BigQuery, Gemini interprets user goals and coordinates the workflow, Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform hosts the integrated production flow, and Veo 3 plus Nano Banana render the final video and image assets.
